We are a dynamic team who love to spend our time doing sporting activities. We even organize our own sports games in the summer. We go to a cool place outside the city, usually with a sauna and a place to swim, and play different games. There are some basketball and volleyball enthusiasts among us, so those are usually on the program, but the main objective is to chill and have fun together.

We treat our colleagues like a big family. So, naturally, we like to celebrate the Christmas season together. We usually enjoy a festive dinner, then gather around the Christmas tree to recite poems, sing, have performances and receive a gift. After that, we relax in a casual atmosphere with some activities and drink mulled wine.

title: Prague | Jobs
content:
# Prague

Ahoj! Welcome to Pipedrive Prague, a development center in the beautiful heart of Europe.

See open positions

## About us

Our Prague office is a dynamic engineering hub buzzing with diversity, culture and innovation. Home to 30+ talented teammates from more than ten countries, it’s a space designed to spark ideas and foster collaboration.

Movie-themed meeting rooms – including a Harry Potter fan favorite – make it a vibrant spot for team off-sites, attracting colleagues from across the globe.

Beyond work, we actively support Prague’s tech, data and HR communities, hosting regular meetups to share knowledge and inspire the next generation of talent.

## Our traditions

Our small, agile Prague team thrives on collaboration and innovation. A favorite tradition of ours is Lightning Talks, which began here in Prague to give people a safe, informal space to practice presenting. They’re optional, relaxed and always leave us feeling a little more inspired.

We take work-life balance seriously, with flexible hours that cater to night owls and early birds alike. Our office vibe is fun and welcoming, from foosball matches and ready-to-ride skateboards to carefully chosen coffee and tea, with a touch of Estonian flair from our slippers and sauna.

Connection is important at our Prague office, and we see it in the moments we share. Communal breakfasts, pickle-making and countless self-organized events capture the close-knit spirit that defines our team. We swap tips in our Prague-only Slack channels (prague-beauty, prague-investing and more), and when we clock out, you’ll find us belting out tunes during karaoke nights.

## Where you’ll find us

Our journey began in a co-working space, but in March 2020, we moved into a new office designed specifically for us. It’s located in a thriving Prague neighborhood – Karlín – and we’re sure we’re the first office in Prague with a sauna! We really enjoy the enchanting atmosphere here, which combines history and the pulse of modern business – complete with Harry Potter and Narnia-themed rooms that make work feel just a little more magical.

Our new home, Praga Studios, was recognized as one of the greenest buildings in the world. You can admire our beehives while drinking your coffee on the rooftop terrace with an amazing city view. Or, if you have green thumbs, try gardening right next to the building!

## Meet our team

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

**Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI):** Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

## **About the Role & Team**

Every AI insight, every experiment, every cohort at Amplitude starts with a query. Our in-house OLAP engine, **Nova**, processes trillions of events in real time — turning raw behavioral data into fast, trustworthy answers that power decisions for thousands of product teams worldwide.

We’re entering a world where AI agents don’t just assist product teams — they ship features, run experiments, and make prioritization calls autonomously. What makes that possible is agents’ ability to verify their work against real product data continuously. That makes Nova the critical infrastructure in the loop, and as non-stop agents become the main source of queries, the demand on Nova’s throughput, correctness, and operational rigor grows dramatically.

We’re looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** who wants to go deep on both the engine internals and the infrastructure underneath it. You’ll work across the full stack of a modern OLAP system — query planning and execution, columnar storage and encoding, distributed compute, caching, and cloud infrastructure — while driving meaningful improvements to performance, cost-efficiency, and reliability at scale. You’ll influence technical direction through your work, your design reviews, and your mentorship of other engineers on a team of ~10.

This role is ideal for someone who finds real satisfaction in making a complex distributed system faster, cheaper, and more reliable — and who wants to do that work on a system that directly powers the product experience for thousands of customers.

title: Staff Engineer - Content Intelligence Infrastructure | Life at Spotify
content:
# Staff Engineer

### Content Intelligence Infrastructure

Link copied to clipboard.

Apply now

Apply

Engineering

Backend

Permanent

London or Stockholm

The Experience team designs Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Content Intelligence Product Area is a core part of Spotify’s Content Platform within the Experience mission. We build systems that create deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images before it reaches users. This enables automation, safety, and entirely new product experiences. Our work powers content enrichment, quality analysis, annotation platforms, and scalable intelligence systems that allow teams across Spotify to build without needing direct content understanding expertise.

We’re now looking for a Staff Engineer to help build and scale foundational infrastructure powering content understanding across Spotify. This role sits at the intersection of backend systems, ML infrastructure, distributed data systems, and AI-enabled platform capabilities. You’ll help shape infrastructure strategy across the product area while partnering with senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional teams to execute on long-term technical investments.

What You'll Do

+ Lead the design and evolution of data, backend and ML infrastructure systems powering Spotify’s content intelligence capabilities
+ Build scalable infrastructure for multimodal content processing across audio, video, text, and image understanding pipelines
+ Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and senior engineers to shape technical strategy across the Content Intelligence Product Area
+ Drive architectural decisions across distributed systems, ML infrastructure, data processing platforms, and platform reliability
+ Improve infrastructure supporting AI and LLM-enabled workflows, including podcast and audiobook transcript processing, metadata enrichment, and content understanding systems
+ Develop reliable and cost-efficient systems for high-throughput content processing and real-time intelligence use cases
+ Collaborate across organizational boundaries to drive alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform investments

# Senior Frontend Engineer (m/f/d)

Remote, Leer

Full-time

Permanent employee

## Role

Everything our users see runs on Next.js and React, and we'd like to hand it to you: the design system it's built from, how fast it loads, and whether everyone can actually use it.

You'll work closely with our software architects, product owners, and fellow developers: code reviews, pair programming, and the technical decisions that stick around.

## Your mission

* You build and maintain our design system in React and Tailwind, so features stay consistent instead of being rebuilt from scratch each time.
* You own frontend performance in Next.js 16 — rendering strategy, bundle size, and what people actually experience on a mediocre connection.
* You treat accessibility as a default, not as cleanup at the end of the sprint.
* You develop the Node.js layer (Express.js, Nest.js) between the UI and our backend services, with Redis where caching helps.
* You push for clean code and automated testing, and you share what you know instead of sitting on it.
* You use coding agents as part of your daily workflow — directing their work, reviewing their output, and fixing what doesn't hold up. Writing code matters; knowing what good code looks like matters more.

## Your profile

* You've spent several years building production frontends with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* You know Tailwind CSS well and you've managed client-side state with Zustand.
* You test what you build — unit and component tests with Vitest, end-to-end tests with Playwright.
* You're comfortable in Node.js with Express.js or Nest.js, and working against APIs from a microservices backend.
* You work well in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), you write clearly, and you're comfortable in English.
* You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or the experience that makes one unnecessary.

## Nice to have

* You've worked with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. We're not in the cloud yet, so this is a plus, not a requirement.

## How you think

We care as much about how you approach a problem as about which frameworks you know. You look past the edges of your own ticket: you notice when a fix really belongs in a different service, you question a process once it has stopped making sense, and you judge your work by whether the whole system got better — not by whether your part shipped. "Not my code" isn't a sentence we use much around here.

## Why us?

You're joining at a point where the engineering foundations themselves are being rebuilt around AI-native workflows — not retrofitted onto legacy decisions, but designed now, while the architecture is still being shaped. That means you don't inherit someone else's five-year-old choices: you help make the calls on how services are split, where AI agents fit into the workflow, and what "good" looks like technically around here. We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

By now the drive is a track record, not a promise. You have years of hard problems behind you and it shows. You understand the whole stack, or you close any gap in it fast, and the hard problems are the ones you go looking for. You are the one who takes the piece nobody else can crack and finds a way through, then leaves the ground solid enough for everyone else to build on.
